description:
Shelter areas for Complex emergency, South Sudan, 18 December 2013 (CE20131218SSD): 3,897 features merged from 1 source layer. Polygon layers with shelter or camp columns, or whose names mention camps, shelters, IDPs, or settlements. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from. The geometry is in EPSG:3857, the CRS of the source layers; the PMTiles copy is in Web Mercator.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Rapid Satellite Imagery Assessment and IDP Shelter Analysis - South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-rapid-satellite-imagery-assessment-and-idp-shelter-analysis-south-december-08-2015)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Geoeye-1; 1 = Worldview-1; 2 = Worldview-2; 3 = Worldview-3; 4 = QuickBird. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: Analyzed
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = No Analyzed; 1 = Analyzed. The decoded text is in `Analyzed_label`.

table:columns.name: Cloud
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = No clouds; 1 = Clouds > 50%. The decoded text is in `Cloud_label`.

table:columns.name: Destroyed
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = No Destruction; 1 = Medium Destruction; 2 = Devastation. The decoded text is in `Destroyed_label`.

table:columns.name: Looting
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = No looting; 1 = Visible Looting. The decoded text is in `Looting_label`.

table:columns.name: IDPs
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = No IDPs; 1 = Visible IDPs. The decoded text is in `IDPs_label`.

table:columns.name: Cows
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = No cows; 1 = Visible cows. The decoded text is in `Cows_label`.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Analyzed_label
table:columns.description: `Analyzed` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Cloud_label
table:columns.description: `Cloud` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Cows_label
table:columns.description: `Cows` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Destroyed_label
table:columns.description: `Destroyed` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: IDPs_label
table:columns.description: `IDPs` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Looting_label
table:columns.description: `Looting` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
